preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= 2e5 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), and the second line contains exactly n integers a_1, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 2·10^5).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= 5 for x in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == n)
postconditions.description: If no convenient fingering exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains exactly n integers b_1, ..., b_n (1 ≤ b_i ≤ 5), each representing a valid finger assignment.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(1 <= i < n and ((a[i] < a[i+1] and b[i] < b[i+1]) or (a[i] > a[i+1] and b[i] > b[i+1]) or (a[i] == a[i+1] and b[i] != b[i+1])) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: For every pair of consecutive notes (a_i, a_{i+1}), the corresponding fingers (b_i, b_{i+1}) satisfy: if a_i < a_{i+1} then b_i < b_{i+1}; if a_i > a_{i+1} then b_i > b_{i+1}; if a_i == a_{i+1} then b_i ≠ b_{i+1}. Here, a = list(map(int, stdin.split()[1:])), b = list(map(int, stdout.split())).
